result:
I’d make it harder for people to stop seeing each other as human.

Not by forcing agreement, kindness, or obedience — just by making dehumanization feel less possible. If people could consistently feel that the stranger, the enemy, the stranger’s government, the person online, the body across the line, the child, the old man, the refugee, the critic — all of them — are as fully real as they are, then so much of the world’s suffering would lose its fuel.

Not a perfect world. Just a less monstrous one.
